structure.title: Fees when I want work
structure.description: At BitTasker, we believe in rewarding loyalty. The more tasks you complete, the less you pay in fees. Our dynamic tier system ensures that our most active workers enjoy the best rates.
structure.areas: These rates are the same for Tasks, Services, Buy & Sell, and Temporary Staff. Bitcoin and USDT use the same fee: 2.5%, 2.0%, or 1.5% per side.
structure.note: Save money as you use BitTasker! Our unique tier system rewards active workers with progressively lower fees.

bitcoin.description: Bitcoin, Lightning, and USDT use the same fee. There is no separate standard rate.
bitcoin.example: As a Hash Master tier worker, a $100 task nets you $98.50. Bitcoin, Lightning, and USDT use that same rate.

repeat.title: Repeat customer bonus
repeat.description: Establish strong customer relationships and enjoy significantly reduced fees on repeat work!

benefits.title: What you get for the work
benefits.description: Higher tier workers enjoy additional benefits beyond reduced fees:
benefits.item_1: Enhanced Visibility: Higher tier workers appear at the top of search results
benefits.item_2: Badge Recognition: Earn prestigious tier badges displayed on your profile
benefits.item_3: Bid Priority: Your proposals are highlighted and prioritized in customers' lists
benefits.item_4: Competitive Edge: Customers can see your tier status, giving you an advantage

maintenance.title: Tier Advancement & Maintenance
maintenance.description: Your tier status is calculated based on your activity over the past 30 days, and is updated daily. The more tasks you complete, the higher your tier and the lower your fees.

cta.title: Ready to start earning with the most competitive fees in the industry?

repeat_bonus.title: Repeat customers mean higher pay
repeat_bonus.description: When a customer books you for a repeat task:
repeat_bonus.note_1: Example: For a $100 repeat task, you'll earn $99, whether the customer pays with Bitcoin, Lightning, or USDT.
repeat_bonus.note_2: Booking repeat work with a customer counts towards your 30 day rolling tasks to maintain your tier.
